introduction: Explore the Transparent Tower, recover the scepter and follow three independent companion requests to the librarian's mist key. Four exchanges, fourteen contacts and eleven optional checks explain current native acceptance. Active, ready accounting is required. Supplied proofs fit; puzzle, source, defeat, epic-touch and escape objectives need separate accepted evidence.
orientation: Meet the actual recipients before using addressed ASK topics. Twenty-six dialogue families explain the tower, companions, books and escape. Words do not independently award quest credit or prove learning.

The ordinary scepter route uses the illithid's warped key, the white mist's swirl key, then Aceralde's marble key for the sitting-room desk. All four progression keys, including the later mist reward, have a hundred-percent normal-unlock break chance. Current carried keys are optional snapshots, not durable access history.

The scepter is placed inside a locked, pickproof white marble desk. Opening it triggers a three-charge room-wide acid trap. Take the exact scepter out into loose carried inventory before offering it. A supplied scepter bypasses this personal recovery route.

Gullivier, Devilish and Lisa independently accept the scepter kind, return that kind and give one identical pale purple token before departing. The returned scepter does not guarantee the same UID. Each request records only its own recipient outcome.

The librarian wants three tokens of that common kind plus the scepter together. Three unique sources, all three earlier personal receipts, a particular order, allegiance and defeating Aceralde are not native requirements. Supplied proofs remain valid.

Gullivier's green-door portal uses SOUTH into the field. Find the hidden downward grass route and eastern wall past the blue mist dragon. His return-tree portal uses SOUTH; eastward reward prose needs builder review.

Devilish's red-door portal uses SOUTH into Avernus. Beneath its tree is his chamber. SAY illusion at the iron door to unlock and reveal it, then OPEN it. The portal beyond returns on EAST; the purple obelisk instead returns on SCREAM.
Lisa's lower-stair open-book portal uses SOUTH into the shadow dragon cave. Open the hidden eastern door to her chamber. Her return-tree portal uses SOUTH.

The fountain's hidden west route leads to the descending slide and mist-covered library approach. A stair portal also sends WEST into the slide. READ the library room's book portal to reach the lower stair. Ordinary room exits alone do not describe every valid route.

After the librarian exchange, use the mist key at the green mist door from the lower stair. SAY reality at the secret wall, then OPEN it; the accepted word unlocks and reveals the reciprocal directions but leaves them closed. The closet portal uses SOUTH to the drawbridge.

The first door portal uses STARE, not LOOK; the field return uses CRY; book controls use their specified commands. Named controls must select the actual object. A successful command, travel arrival or return needs its own accepted event before becoming a story objective.

The closet's rune of blue power uses the shared durable epic-touch transaction. Its reward and group participation are separate from the token exchange and from actual escape. Story integration should consume its committed result, not a typed TOUCH or descriptive glow.

The globe of shadows and shadowcraft mace belong to tower prototypes but their active declared sources are foreign: the Chronomancer and Chernovog. Their actual artifact effects and the globe's pet benefit are separate from local quest rewards. Two trash prototypes carry a stone-effect binding without an active local source; builder intent remains pending.

One ordinary southern exit from the western stair reaches the drawbridge. This source route does not enforce the narrative's closet-only escape claim. Illusion-themed direction mismatches and escape policy need builder confirmation before native repairs.

All four exchanges remain separate story outcomes; only the librarian recipe has native daily shape. Retiring companions, reset mode one, shared supply, current access, actual encounters and active, ready accounting govern repeats. No full-tower rescue, epic-touch or escape achievement is invented.

contacts.name: Lord Gullivier
contacts.description: Gullivier starts beyond the field and blue mist dragon. Ask tower, escape and the other companions for lore; only the accepted scepter exchange records this outcome.

contacts.name: Lord Devilish
contacts.description: Devilish waits beneath the Avernus tree. Ask tower, aceralde or scepter; the escape words and return controls are separate from his token receipt.

contacts.name: the purple librarian
contacts.description: The purple librarian waits in the lower library. Ask escape, books or the companions. He accepts the exact four-root batch and gives the mist key, without enforcing three distinct token sources.

contacts.name: Lady Lisa
contacts.description: Lisa waits beyond the shadow dragon and hidden eastern door. Ask tower, aceralde or scepter. Her receipt returns the scepter kind and one common token.

contacts.name: Aceralde
contacts.description: Aceralde starts in his chamber with the marble desk key and two following undead. The scepter is in the separate sitting-room desk. His custom pulse registration needs qualification; a key or token receipt proves no personal defeat.

contacts.name: a sickly illithid
contacts.description: The illithid starts in the second-floor bedroom with the warped steel key. Actual current custody and combat conditions govern recovery.

contacts.name: A white mist
contacts.description: The white mist starts beyond the locked kitchen steel door with the swirl key for the upper ebonwood door.

contacts.name: a blue mist dragon
contacts.description: The blue mist dragon guards the hidden route to Gullivier. Its armor is ordinary loot; no kill receipt is required by the token exchange.

contacts.name: a shadow dragon
contacts.description: The shadow dragon guards the cave entered by the lower-stair book portal. The hidden east route leads to Lisa; no recorded defeat is a native prerequisite.

contacts.name: a lost adventurer
contacts.description: The lost adventurer supplies tower atmosphere without an active local rescue or escort endpoint. Do not treat decorative soul lore as a completed rescue.

contacts.name: the angry mage
contacts.description: The angry mage is another trapped tower resident. Its ordinary combat and lore do not create a fifth native token request.

contacts.name: a guardian mist
contacts.description: The closet guardian is a separate combatant at the mist-key and spoken-reality route. The closet portal uses SOUTH to the drawbridge; actual escape needs a successful-arrival event.

contacts.name: a skeletal lich
contacts.description: Aceralde's following lich wears wrist bones. Ordinary follower combat and a possible custom recharm pulse are separate from the four exchanges.

contacts.name: an ugly vampire
contacts.description: Aceralde's following vampire wears an earring. Recovering equipment is not a named story terminal or proof of freeing all inhabitants.

stories.title: Gullivier's pale purple token
stories.summary: Use the green-door portal south into the field, then the hidden down and east routes past the blue mist dragon. The return-tree portal uses SOUTH, despite eastward reward prose. Gullivier accepts the scepter, returns its kind and gives one token before departing. The three companion requests are independent; each produces the same token kind.
